description_en: Queries the detailed information about a primary/secondary server group
description_zh: 查询指定主备服务器组的详细信息
name: DescribeMasterSlaveServerGroupAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the primary/secondary server group
parameters.name: master_slave_server_group_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the CLB instance was created. The time follows the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
CreateTime.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例创建时间，格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The ID of the associated CLB instance
LoadBalancerId.description_zh: 关联的传统型负载均衡实例ID

MasterSlaveBackendServer.description_en: A list of backend servers in the primary/secondary server group

items.description_en: The backend servers in the primary/secondary server group

Description.description_en: The description of the primary/secondary server group
Description.example: The description of the primary/secondary server group.

Port.description_en: The port that is used by the backend server
Port.description_zh: 后端服务器使用的端口

ServerId.description_en: The ID of the backend server

ServerType.description_en: The type of backend server. Valid values: Master and Slave

Type.description_en:
The type of the backend server. Valid values:

ecs (default): Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance

eni: elastic network interface (ENI)

eci: elastic container instance
Type.description_zh:
后端服务器类型，取值：

ecs（默认）：ECS实例。

eni：弹性网卡实例。

eci：弹性容器实例

Weight.description_en: The weight of the backend server

MasterSlaveServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the primary/secondary server group

MasterSlaveServerGroupName.description_en: The name of the primary/secondary server group

TagKey.description_en:
The tag key. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`
TagKey.description_zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`

TagValue.description_en:
The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag value cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`
TagValue.description_zh:
实例的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
